answers.q1: A meeting recording has just started (00:02 elapsed). The app is listening for speech but nothing has been said yet, so the transcript, decisions, and action items all show placeholder 'waiting' text.
answers.q2: The recording status itself: the red dot + '録音中 00:02' timer at top-left and the '聞いています...' (listening) line, which confirm the app is actively capturing the meeting right now.
answers.q3: You can control the recording from the floating black toolbar (pause, comment, expand, more, stop), type a question about the meeting in the bottom input bar, or check 'AI が見ている資料' (materials the AI is viewing). The 要約/質問する/決定事項/アクション buttons are grayed out and not yet usable.
answers.q4: Only partially. The listening indicator and dotted animation next to the timer suggest something is happening, but with zero transcript text and no visible audio waveform/level meter, there's no concrete proof yet that speech is actually being captured or understood.
answers.q5: The '...' overflow menu and expand icon on the floating toolbar feel premature this early; the four bottom action buttons (リアルタイム要約/質問する/決定事項/アクション) being shown fully but disabled adds visual clutter before there's any content to act on.
answers.q6: The black floating toolbar at the top center, mainly because of the red recording dot and stop button contrasting against the light background.

weaknesses.what: Four disabled bottom buttons (リアルタイム要約, 質問する, 決定事項, アクション) are rendered at full visual weight even though they can't be used yet, competing with the live 'waiting' content above them.
weaknesses.fix: Dim/collapse these into a single lightweight affordance until the meeting produces enough content to enable them.

weaknesses.what: There is no visible waveform or audio-level meter proving the microphone is actually picking up sound, only a static '聞いています...' label, so a first-time user can't visually confirm audio capture is live.
weaknesses.fix: Add a small live waveform or level indicator next to '聞いています...' that reacts to actual sound input.

weaknesses.what: The screen is entirely gray/utilitarian placeholder text ('待っています...') with no warmth or motion cues at the exciting moment a meeting just started.
weaknesses.fix: Add a subtle animated pulse or friendly first-run microcopy to make the start-of-recording moment feel alive rather than empty.
